answer: Every agent identity must register a nullifier in a public registry before it can earn, each tied to one non-transferable credential, so the same credential can never spawn a second identity. The registry is open, so anyone can verify a nullifier in seconds. A funder that sponsors three identities later proven fake has every identity it funded frozen, and the 600-token bond behind each, locked 45 epochs, is slashed 100 percent. The onyx ledger records each funding link, so a gale of new accounts from one source collapses at once. At the nadir, 1,000 fakes cost 600,000 tokens locked and lost.
